items.author: davidcrockett08.bsky.social
items.context: I just remember there being some Roger Rabbit Dos game where I couldn't even get out of the first room and there was no way in heck to figure out how to do that. Ol' Rog specialized in inspiring childhood failure, I think.
items.text: Early DOS adventure games rarely told you what to do, so you were not alone in getting stuck in that first room.

items.author: pinchofdom.bsky.social
items.context:
What game was a big part of your childhood? Before the joys of a getting a PlayStation, nothing beat playing games on ye ol Windows 95
2 images: Putt-Putt Enters the Race (1999) / Pajama Sam 2: Thunder and Lightning Aren't so Frightening (1998); quotes @creamysaucy.bsky.social: What game was a big part of your childhood?
items.text: Putt-Putt and Pajama Sam were the best. Humongous Entertainment made so many childhood favorites.
